A '''voice recorder''' was a data storage device that could record and carry verbal data.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> The [[Aaris]] civilization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aaris III]] used voice recorders as their culture communicated by sounds more than writing.<ref name="AOA">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Artifact of Aaris|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref>
